history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration explore ways to create a dedicated team for a smooth global roll- out of the common back offices and the development of the information technology platform to support it.
history.administration_response: The Business Innovations Group established two teams to support the roll-out of the efficiency agenda in general, with a particular focus on common back offices. Consisting of senior-level staff of the 8+1, or nine, largest United Nations field entities, the groups are: (a) the 8+1 Assistant Secretary-General group (with Assistant Secretary-General-level participation), formally known as the High-level Forum of the Business Innovations Group. To date, the group has met twice in 2021, in February and June. The minutes of those meetings also reflect the strong focus on the roll- out of the common back offices. The next meeting is scheduled for December 2021; and (b) the 8+1 reference group of senior directors (with Senior Director-level participation). The reference group reports to the Assistant Secretary- General group and met in April and June 2021. It held a two-day retreat in November on the roll-out of the common back offices. The group is also overseeing the work on the development of the information technology platform. Based on the above, the Administration requests that the Board close this recommendation, as all agreed actions have been implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that the two teams have been established, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
